question: What is the duration of freedom from return for one who attains this result?
premises: A return or rebirth is possible in general
Even immense cosmic ages do not bring return
inference: For such a one there is no return, even across hundreds of crores of cosmic ages.
uncertainties: Whether tasya refers to the person or the state is context-dependent.
plain_english: There is no return for him, even in hundreds of crores of cosmic ages.
